headline: Chest-high and short-period — fun at dawn but not drive-worthy.
today: Solid-looking 2-3ft SE at a good angle, but the 4s period keeps it weak and the wind is only cross-off right at dawn before going cross. Fine if you're local, not worth 2.5 hours from the city. Log at dawn on the morning push.

daysToWatch.note: Onshore S at 13mph from dawn on — blown out despite a prime SE angle. Skip.
Rebuild to 2-3ft but from a marginal E angle, so junky even with offshore morning wind. Don't make the drive.
